title: Care-Level Rates for Withholding Proposals — Veterans Pension and Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery
content:
The care level of a debtor's running **Veterans Pension** award sets a care rate on the monthly withholding proposed on a reduced-withholding request for a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery**.

| Running Veterans Pension rate category | Care rate |
|---|---|
| Aid and Attendance — Veterans Pension (Aid and Attendance, No Dependents) or Veterans Pension (Aid and Attendance, One Dependent) | 70 percent (aid-and-attendance rate) |
| Housebound — Veterans Pension (Housebound, No Dependents) or Veterans Pension (Housebound, One Dependent) | 80 percent (housebound rate) |
| Basic Rate, or no running pension | No care rate under this table |

The care rate is a percentage by which the starting figure of the proposal is multiplied before the proposal is rounded up to the cent; it acts on that starting figure itself. The category is read from the debtor's running Veterans Pension award.

**Hypothetical cases.** A starting figure of 138.00 USD for an Aid and Attendance pensioner: 138.00 multiplied by 70 percent, that is 96.60 USD. For a Housebound pensioner: 110.40 USD. For a Basic Rate pensioner: no care rate under this table.
